overview_description.description:
RethinkDB is the first open-source scalable database for the realtime web. It exposes an exciting new access model -- instead of polling for changes, the developer can tell the database to continuously push updated query results to applications in realtime. RethinkDB allows developer to build scalable realtime apps in a fraction of the time with fewer engineering resources.

RethinkDB features a pleasant and powerful query language that has useful queries like table joins and groupBy, a highly parallelized architecture, and web tools for managing clusters.

product.name: RethinkDB Database
product.description: An open-source distributed NoSQL database designed to store JSON documents and support realtime data push to applications.

product.name: ReQL Query Language
product.description: A query language for RethinkDB that enables complex queries, realtime changefeeds, and data manipulation on JSON documents.

product.name: Cluster Management and Scaling Tools
product.description: Tools and APIs for managing RethinkDB clusters, including sharding, replication, reconfiguration, and monitoring.

product.name: Geospatial Query Support
product.description: Geospatial data types and queries enabling storage, indexing, and querying of geographic data within RethinkDB.

product.name: Write Hooks
product.description: A feature that allows users to define deterministic functions that modify documents during write operations in RethinkDB.
